edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] (the “Settlement Amount”) no later than [PAYMENT DEADLINE]. The parties must complete these terms in the final agreement.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims asserted in [IDENTIFY ACTION OR MATTER] that arise out of the matters being settled by this Agreement. No release is effective before receipt of cleared funds.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that a party may disclose them to the extent required by law, court order, or governmental authority, or to that party’s attorneys, accountants, auditors, tax advisers, insurers, and other professional advisers who are informed of the confidential nature of the information.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the settlement amount to be agreed by the parties (the “Settlement Amount”). The Settlement Amount and payment deadline shall be set forth in the final agreement. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
